Usage is billed per million requests, on the first day of each month, for the month before. The first million requests each month are free.

Unpaid invoices suspend write access after 14 days; reads keep working.

Each API key may make 600 requests per minute. A request over the limit gets status 429 with a `Retry-After` header in seconds.

Batch endpoints count as one request per item in the batch, up to 100 items.

# Regions

Tessera runs in three regions: `us-east`, `eu-west` and `ap-south`. Data never leaves the region it was written in.

A project is tied to one region when it is created. To move it, export the project and import it in the new region.

rows.text: To move a project, export it from its current region and import it into the target region (`us-east`, `eu-west`, or `ap-south`). Note that a project is tied to the region it was created in, and data never leaves that region, so the export/import is the only documented path.
